question: Do the saved row-level records, de-duplicated by seed and revision, meet the unchanged prospective useful-derivation conditions, and does preparation chronology cover all five models before any evaluation?
scope: Read-only aggregation and cross-artifact identity check. No model execution, population generation, statistical refit or new scientific test family.
inputs: Frozen config; 160 preserved retention unit JSON files and the separately recovered aggregate; saved retention/neural assessments; preparation completion, pre-exposure validation and evaluation markers.
rule: Preserve the attempt directory and every failure. A deterministic reader defect may be corrected transparently in a new audit attempt; it never authorizes an experimental retry or a frozen edit.
